notes: Booklet is low-resolution; piece-to-step mapping was inferred and made to match the official parts list exactly (51 pieces).
Build order: body steps 1-15, arms (step 16, 2x), head wedges (17-18), base (19), top plate and crystal (20), then leg sub-assemblies (pages 11-14) attached in 21/22.
The two leg sub-assemblies are mirror variants: one has the pearl gold cheese slope on the plate and the light bluish gray one on the slope, the other the reverse.
Leg towballs are assumed to go into the two 14704 socket plates. Eye ball joints are assumed to attach by the bottom pin of the 3040b slopes.
Sideways attachments (bracket walls with outward studs) are recorded as rests_on of the clutching piece.
The base 2654, the feet 3022 and the arm handle plates 60478 are first-placed pieces whose studs push into parts above, so rests_on is empty and the join is in other_joins.
